title: Animal Welfare Groups' Involvement in Trap-Neuter-Rehome/Release-Manage Programme
what_it_is: Animal Welfare Groups' Involvement in Trap-Neuter-Rehome/Release-Manage Programme

sections.label: TNRM trapping operations with AVS
sections.summary: AVS works with TNRM partners to trap unsterilised free-roaming dogs, citing a Seletar West Farmway 8 operation that removed three dogs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Our TNRM partners play key roles, including conducting trapping and sterilisation operations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Upon identification of an unsterilised free-roaming dog, AVS will work with the TNRM partner responsible for the designated area to commence trapping operations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For instance, in the case of the recent trapping operation at Seletar West Farmway 8 on 14 November 2025, AVS' animal management contractor was activated to trap and remove three free-roaming dogs, which were confirmed by several victims to have been involved in multiple chasing and biting incidents.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The operation was carried out safely under the supervision of AVS staff and is in line with existing protocols under TNRM.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: This includes complying with the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) standards on Stray Dog Population Control to ensure that uncovered wire loops or ropes were not used during the trapping process and also giving due consideration to personnel and animal safety in determining the restraint procedures.

sections.label: TNRM protocols and programme results
sections.summary: AVS refines TNRM protocols with AWGs and reports trapping 4,470 dogs, rehoming 2,048 and sterilising 80% of the free-roaming dog population.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Indeed, there is a lot of discussion and collaboration between AVS and the AWGs, and that is why we are also refining the TNRM protocols.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: That includes the management of free-roaming dogs, the review of various trapping measures and also, how to further improve coordination and collaboration between AVS and our TNRM partners.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In fact, when I visited them on Friday, I encouraged them to join our TNRM workshop that is scheduled for 15 January, which is Thursday.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: On the effectiveness of the TNRM programme, while Members might know that it started in 2018, we have thus far trapped 4,470 dogs, rehomed 2,048 dogs and sterilised 80% of the free-roaming dog population.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: That is above our target of 70% and that has resulted in a reduction of 80% of feedback cases.
